about: The production ownership registry (design/PLAN-bot-dedicated-checkout-2026-09-25.md W0.3, D4). Every scheduled writer that leaves a file dirty or untracked in the production checkout (the main checkout, C:\Codex\ThriftyCrew) declares it here, beside the capture bot and the three lanes, which declare theirs in lib/bot-paths.ps1 and lib/pipeline-commit.ps1 and are NOT repeated here. A dirty or untracked path no declaration owns is UNREGISTERED. Patterns follow Test-BotPathOwned: an entry owns its subtree (the boundary is the slash), and * or ? make it a -like glob. ADDING A PATH IS A DECISION SOMEBODY DEFENDS IN A DIFF: name the writer and the evidence.
intruder_policy_about: D4, ruled (b) on 2026-09-25: set an unregistered file on a moved path aside into the dated quarantine, page, and proceed. It switches on ONLY after ops/report-production-intruders.ps1 reads 0 unregistered producer paths for 7 clean days (W2.2). Until then, and as the kill switch after, 'wait' is today's rule exactly: the sync goes partial or blocked and pages.
